answer: Earnings can vest like a glacier: a pending mass advancing one step per epoch, which no volume of extra work accelerates. Waiting alone parallelises for free, so each epoch a tide drawn from the seed selects an unpredictable subset to sit a fresh challenge; failing melts the mass to zero. Spendable weight then grows only as ivory does - accreted, never purchasable or transferred. Turning N puppets into N payers means keeping every one passing unannounced re-audits across the window: cost is N times epochs, continuous, each puppet's credit forfeit on one miss.
